sections.heading: UK-Based AI Consulting With Flexible Delivery
intro: As a practical [AI consulting](/ai-consulting) partner, Commview is based in Manchester and is set up to work remotely with clients across the UK and internationally.

Location should not dictate the [operating model](/ai-consulting/business-operations). Workshops, stakeholder sessions and delivery can happen remotely, with in-person work used where being in the room materially improves discovery, alignment or [AI implementation](/ai-consulting/implementation).

sections.heading: AI Consulting Informed by B2B Operating Experience
sections.intro: The experience behind Commview spans sectors including telecommunications, industrial and distribution businesses, retail and professional environments. That is prior operator experience, not a claim that each sector is a Commview AI client.

items.q: Do you work with UK-based clients only?
items.a: No. Commview is based in Manchester but can work with organisations across the UK and internationally. Most strategy, workflow design, analysis and implementation work can be delivered remotely. The right delivery model depends on the client, systems and stakeholders rather than the location of the office.

items.q: How does UK data protection law affect AI implementation?
items.a: UK AI implementations still need to handle personal data in line with applicable data protection obligations, including the UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018 where relevant. The exact requirements depend on the data and use case. We design data access and controls into the workflow and recommend specialist legal advice where the implementation creates material compliance questions.

items.q: Do you meet clients in person or remote-only?
items.a: Both are possible. Commview is Manchester-based and works remote-first because it keeps delivery flexible across locations. In-person sessions can be useful for discovery, leadership alignment, workshops or complex operating decisions. We use them when they improve the work rather than making travel part of the engagement by default.
